description:
A single public Telegram channel message by link: text, media, views, date, forward info, link preview and channel info.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Provide one of: `url` OR `post` OR `username` + `id`.
Returns: channel (object), id (integer, nullable), post (string), link (string), type (string), text (string), photo_urls (array<string>), video_url (string, nullable), video_thumb_url (string, nullable), video_duration (string, nullable), view_count (integer, nullable), view_count_text (string, nullable), posted_at (string, nullable), is_forwarded (boolean), forwarded_from (string, nullable), link_preview (object, nullable).

id.description: Message ID; only together with username. Example: 342

username.description: Channel username; only together with id. Example: "durov"

name: telegram_post
title: Telegram post
